# ACME Cloud – commercial offer (summary)

- Service level: 99.9% monthly availability for the production tier.
- Support: business hours (08:00–18:00 CET), Monday to Friday. 24/7 support is an optional add-on, not included in this offer.
- Data residency: all customer data stays in EU data centres (Frankfurt and Warsaw).
- Contract term: 36 months.
